name: Maria Avocado
description: A premium grafted avocado selected for Belize gardens. Reliable producer with excellent fruit quality.
flavorProfile: Maria avocados have a rich, creamy texture with a mild nutty flavor. The flesh is smooth and buttery — ideal for spreading, salads, or enjoying fresh.

name: Febroy Avocado
description: March-crop variety grown for Belize conditions. Grafted and certified.
flavorProfile: Febroy avocados offer a mild, refreshing flavor with a lighter, less oily texture. A clean tasting fruit that shines in salads and ceviche.

name: April Avocado
description: A popular Belize favorite. Grafted and certified for reliable production.
flavorProfile: The April avocado has a light, mild flavor with a slightly watery texture. It's less creamy than other varieties, offering a refreshing, subtle taste with a hint of nuttiness.

name: Early Avocado
description: An early-season avocado that fruits ahead of most varieties — perfect for extending your harvest.
flavorProfile: Early avocados have a gentle, buttery flavor with a smooth texture. Harvest them first and enjoy avocado season weeks sooner.

name: Butter Delicious
description: Named for its luxurious texture. A standout grafted avocado for home orchards.
flavorProfile: The Butter Delicious avocado is known for its rich, creamy texture and mild, buttery flavor. It offers a slightly nutty taste with a smooth, velvety flesh that's perfect for spreading or adding to salads.

name: Hass Black (Mexican)
description: The world's most loved avocado, adapted for Belize. Dark pebbled skin when ripe.
flavorProfile: The Hass Black avocado has a rich, creamy flavor with a slightly nutty taste. Its smooth, buttery texture makes it a favorite for guacamole, toast, or simply enjoyed on its own.

name: Italian Avocado
description: A smooth-skinned grafted avocado with refined flavor — a nursery favorite.
flavorProfile: The Italian avocado has a smooth, creamy texture with a mild, slightly tangy flavor. It offers a refreshing taste with subtle nutty undertones, making it perfect for both savory and sweet dishes.

name: Chutle Long
description: A distinctive long-neck avocado — limited, very rare, and currently unavailable at the nursery.
flavorProfile: The Chutle avocado has a creamy texture with a mild, slightly sweet flavor. It's smooth and buttery, with a subtle nutty taste, making it perfect for salads, guacamole, or simply enjoyed on toast.

name: Tahiti Lime
description: The classic seedless lime. Juicy, aromatic, and essential for Belize kitchens.
flavorProfile: Tahiti limes have a bright, zesty flavor with a clean acidity and fragrant oils in the peel. Perfect for drinks, marinades, ceviche, and everyday cooking.

name: Jamaican Lime
description: A Caribbean lime with bold aroma and generous juice.
flavorProfile: Jamaican limes are intensely aromatic with a sharp, lively acidity. Their juice is excellent in punches, gravies, and seafood.

name: Sweet Lime
description: A milder lime enjoyed fresh and in juices.
flavorProfile: Sweet limes have a gentle citrus flavor with low acidity. Refreshing to eat fresh or juice — less tart than common limes.

name: Kalamansi Lime
description: Tiny, intensely fragrant citrus used across tropical kitchens.
flavorProfile: Kalamansi has a floral, tart-sweet flavor that sits between lime and mandarin. Extraordinary in drinks, dipping sauces, and desserts.

name: Kaffir Lime
description: Grown for both fruit and the prized double leaves used in cooking.
flavorProfile: Kaffir lime fruit is intensely aromatic and tart. The leaves add unmistakable citrus perfume to curries, soups, and teas.

name: Local Lime
description: Belize's everyday lime — adapted, productive, and kitchen-ready.
flavorProfile: Local limes have a classic sharp citrus bite with plenty of juice. The workhorse lime for Belize cooking.

name: Washington Orange
description: A classic navel-style orange for fresh eating.
flavorProfile: Washington oranges are sweet, juicy, and easy to peel with a classic orange flavor and low seeds.

name: Blood Orange
description: Striking ruby flesh with a flavor unlike any other citrus. A Greenhouse Co-Op signature tree.
flavorProfile: Blood Oranges have a sweet, tangy flavor with hints of raspberry and citrus. Their vibrant, deep red flesh offers a unique balance of tartness and sweetness, perfect for juicing, salads, or enjoying fresh.

name: Honey Orange
description: Exceptionally sweet orange for snacking and juice.
flavorProfile: Honey oranges live up to the name — lush, sweet, and low-acid with a silky juice that's wonderful fresh or blended.

name: Valencia Red Orange
description: A juice orange with a blush of color and late-season fruit.
flavorProfile: Valencia Red oranges are juicy and balanced, with a sweet-tart flavor that makes exceptional juice.

name: Pineapple Orange
description: Named for a tropical sweetness reminiscent of pineapple.
flavorProfile: Pineapple oranges have a sweet, tropical citrus flavor with a hint of pineapple. Juicy and aromatic — excellent fresh or juiced.

name: Hamlin Orange
description: An early, productive juice orange well suited to Belize.
flavorProfile: Hamlin oranges are known for their sweet, tangy flavor with a refreshing, juicy texture. Their bright orange flesh is mild and less acidic, making them perfect for fresh eating, juices, and desserts.

name: Cara-cara Orange
description: Pink-fleshed navel orange with berry notes. A premium grafted citrus.
flavorProfile: Cara-Cara oranges have a sweet, tangy flavor with hints of berry and cherry. Their vibrant pinkish-red flesh is juicy and less acidic, making them perfect for snacking, juicing, or adding to fruit salads.

name: Pink Eurica Lemon
description: A pink-fleshed Eureka-type lemon with ornamental fruit.
flavorProfile: Pink Eurica lemons have a bright lemon tang with a slightly sweeter edge. The blush flesh is beautiful in drinks and garnishes.

name: Lisbon Lemon
description: A vigorous true lemon with abundant, highly acidic fruit.
flavorProfile: Lisbon lemons have a sharp, tangy flavor with a strong acidity. Their juicy flesh is highly tart, making them perfect for zesting, juicing, and adding a bold citrus kick to dishes and drinks.

name: Genoa Lemon
description: A smoother, more aromatic lemon — a chef's favorite.
flavorProfile: Genoa lemons have a bright, tangy flavor with a balance of sweetness and acidity. Their juicy flesh is less tart than traditional lemons, offering a smooth, aromatic taste for beverages, cooking, and desserts.

name: Ponderosa Lemon
description: Remarkably large fruit. A conversation-piece lemon tree.
flavorProfile: Ponderosa lemons have a strong, tangy flavor with a high acidity. They are larger than most lemons, offering a bold, zesty citrus taste that's perfect for juicing, garnishes, or adding intense flavor to dishes.

name: Meyer Lemon
description: The beloved thin-skinned lemon with floral sweetness.
flavorProfile: Meyer lemons are sweeter and more floral than standard lemons, with a perfume of honey and blossom. Perfect for desserts, dressings, and drinks.

name: King Mandarin
description: A large, richly flavored mandarin.
flavorProfile: King mandarins are sweet, deep, and aromatic with easy-to-peel segments. A luxurious snacking citrus.

name: Dancy Mandarin
description: The classic Christmas mandarin — easy to peel and wonderfully fragrant.
flavorProfile: Dancy mandarins have a sweet, tangy flavor with a refreshing citrus taste. Their juicy segments are easy to peel and less acidic, making them ideal for snacking or adding to fruit salads and desserts.

name: Jamaican Mandarin
description: A Caribbean mandarin with vibrant flavor.
flavorProfile: Jamaican mandarins have a sweet, tangy flavor with a smooth, juicy texture. Their easy-to-peel segments are less acidic, offering a vibrant citrus taste perfect for snacking or adding to salads.

name: Kumquat
description: Eat the whole fruit — peel and all. A unique citrus for Belize gardens.
flavorProfile: Kumquats are sweet on the peel and tart in the flesh. Pop them whole for a burst of sweet-sour citrus, or candy and preserve them.

name: Red Grapefruit
description: Classic red-fleshed grapefruit grafted for Belize gardens.
flavorProfile: Red grapefruit is refreshingly bitter-sweet with ruby segments and bright juice. Excellent for breakfast, juices, and savory salads.

name: White Grapefruit
description: Mild white-fleshed grapefruit grafted for Belize gardens.
flavorProfile: White grapefruit has a mellow, slightly sweet flavor with pale, juicy flesh. A gentler grapefruit for fresh eating and juices.

name: Ortanique
description: A tangerine-orange hybrid (also called Ortanich).
flavorProfile: Ortanique are known for their sweet, juicy flavor with a hint of tanginess. Their orange flesh combines the best qualities of a tangerine and an orange. Perfect for fresh use, juices, and desserts.

name: Tangerine
description: Easy-peel citrus with bright, kid-friendly flavor.
flavorProfile: Tangerines are sweet, fragrant, and easy to peel. A daily snacking fruit with sunny citrus flavor.

name: Pomelo
description: The giant ancestor of grapefruit. Red or white flesh.
flavorProfile: Pomelos have a mild, sweet citrus flavor with low bitterness and thick, easy-to-peel rind. Refreshing and impressive.

name: Maley Apple
description: A tropical apple-type fruit adapted to Belize.
flavorProfile: Maley apples have a crisp, mildly sweet flavor with a refreshing bite. Enjoy fresh or in chutneys.

name: Red Custard Apple
description: A striking red-skinned custard apple.
flavorProfile: Red custard apples are sweet, custardy, and fragrant with a melt-in-the-mouth texture.

name: Large Yellow Custard Apple
description: Large-fruited custard apple with pale gold skin.
flavorProfile: Yellow custard apples have a sweet, creamy pulp with tropical vanilla notes. Eat with a spoon.

name: Rose Apple
description: Crisp, rose-scented tropical fruit.
flavorProfile: Rose apples are crisp, watery-sweet, and perfumed with rose. Refreshing eaten chilled.

name: Green Star Apple
description: Star apple with green skin and sweet pulp.
flavorProfile: Green star apples have a sweet, milky pulp with a unique star pattern when sliced.

name: Purple Star Apple
description: The classic caimito with purple skin.
flavorProfile: Purple star apples are sweet and gelatinous with a star of seeds when cut crosswise. A tropical dessert fruit.

name: Glenn Mango
description: A fiberless favorite with gorgeous blush. Grafted for true-to-type fruit.
flavorProfile: Glenn mangoes have a sweet, tropical flavor with a mild tang and a hint of citrus. Their juicy, smooth flesh and minimal fiber make them perfect for fresh eating, smoothies, or fruit salads.

name: Black Mango
description: A rich, dark-blushed mango beloved in Belize.
flavorProfile: Black mangoes have a rich, sweet flavor with subtle tropical notes. Their smooth, creamy texture and slightly fibrous flesh make them perfect for fresh eating, smoothies, or desserts.

name: Cambodiana
description: A fiberless Southeast Asian mango that thrives in Belize heat.
flavorProfile: Cambodiana mangoes have a sweet, slightly tangy flavor with tropical notes. Their smooth, juicy flesh is fiberless, making them ideal for fresh eating, smoothies, or fruit salads.

name: Carrie Mango
description: A compact, fiberless mango — excellent for smaller yards.
flavorProfile: Carrie mangoes have a sweet, rich flavor with subtle hints of peach and citrus. Their smooth, fiberless flesh and creamy texture make them perfect for fresh eating, smoothies, or desserts.

name: Tommy Mango
description: The widely grown Tommy Atkins type — colorful, firm, and productive.
flavorProfile: Tommy mangoes have a mildly sweet flavor with a firm texture that holds up in salsas, salads, and shipping.

name: Pahari Mango
description: A flavorful grafted mango selected for tropical home orchards.
flavorProfile: Pahari mangoes are richly sweet with a tropical perfume and smooth flesh.

name: Haden Mango
description: A classic Florida mango with brilliant color and fine flavor.
flavorProfile: Haden mangoes are sweet and aromatic with a beautiful red blush. A heritage variety that still sets the standard.

name: Julie Dwarf Mango
description: A compact Caribbean mango perfect for smaller Belize yards.
flavorProfile: Julie mangoes are intensely sweet, rich, and fiberless with a distinctive flattened shape. A West Indian legend.

name: Palmer Mango
description: A late-season mango that extends your harvest.
flavorProfile: Palmer mangoes are sweet, fiberless, and large. They ripen later, stretching mango season well into the year.

name: Golden Giant Mango
description: Oversized golden fruit with show-stopping size.
flavorProfile: Golden Giant mangoes are sweet, juicy, and generous. One fruit can feed a family.

name: Gab Julie Mango
description: A Julie-type selection with outstanding eating quality.
flavorProfile: Gab Julie mangoes have the rich, sweet, fiberless flesh Julie lovers expect — a premium eating mango.

name: Keith (Keitt) Mango
description: A late, large, fiberless mango — one of the greats.
flavorProfile: Keith mangoes have a sweet, tangy flavor with tropical notes and a hint of citrus. Their smooth, juicy flesh is fiberless, making them perfect for fresh eating, smoothies, or salsas.

name: Golden Plum
description: A golden tropical plum with sweet flesh.
flavorProfile: Golden plums are sweet, juicy, and honeyed — excellent fresh or in preserves.

name: Large Chinese Plum
description: A premium large-fruited Chinese plum.
flavorProfile: Chinese plums are sweet-tart with a fragrant juice. Beautiful fruit and a generous crop.

name: Chinese Cross Plum
description: A hybrid Chinese plum with excellent flavor.
flavorProfile: Chinese Cross plums balance sweet and tart with a floral aroma. A standout backyard plum.

name: Governor Plum
description: A productive tropical plum for Belize yards.
flavorProfile: Governor plums are sweet-tart with a pleasant bite. Good fresh and excellent preserved.

name: Yellow August Plum
description: A late-summer golden plum.
flavorProfile: Yellow August plums are sweet, aromatic, and sunny — a seasonal treat.

name: Red May Plum
description: An early red plum that ripens in May.
flavorProfile: Red May plums are juicy and sweet-tart with a vivid red skin. One of the first stone fruits of the season.

name: Golden Plum Dwarf
description: Same golden plum fruit as the standard tree — on a compact form that produces sooner with a smaller footprint.
flavorProfile: Same sweet, honeyed golden plum flesh as the standard tree. The dwarf form fruits quicker on a smaller tree — ideal for tighter yards.

name: Strawberry (Deleez)
description: A tropical strawberry selection for Belize conditions. Always in short supply — order while they last.
flavorProfile: Deleez strawberries are sweet, fragrant, and juicy — a rare treat grown for Belize gardens.

name: Cranberry
description: A tart berry for juices and sauces.
flavorProfile: Cranberries are brightly tart and aromatic. Excellent in sauces, juices, and baking.

name: Large Mulberry Dwarf Tree
description: A compact mulberry with large sweet fruit.
flavorProfile: Dwarf mulberries produce large, sweet berries on a smaller tree — perfect for yards.

name: Barbados Berry/ Cherry
description: Acerola cherry — one of the highest natural vitamin C fruits.
flavorProfile: Barbados berries are tart-sweet and intensely vitamin-rich. Outstanding in juices and vitamin shots.

name: Tropical Black Grape
description: A grape selected for tropical heat.
flavorProfile: Tropical black grapes are sweet, juicy, and dark-skinned. Enjoy fresh or as juice.

name: Fig (Brown Turkey)
description: The reliable classic fig.
flavorProfile: Brown Turkey figs are sweet, jammy, and honeyed with a tender skin. Excellent fresh or dried.

name: Fig (Florentina)
description: A premium Italian-type fig.
flavorProfile: Florentina figs are richly sweet with a complex, wine-like flavor and lush red interior.

name: Fig (Black Mission)
description: The iconic dark fig of California — grown here for Belize.
flavorProfile: Black Mission figs are deep, sweet, and berry-like with a dark purple skin and jammy flesh.

name: Peach (Mexican)
description: A low-chill Mexican peach that can fruit in Belize.
flavorProfile: Mexican peaches are fragrant, sweet, and juicy with a classic peach perfume. A special tree.

name: Noni
description: The traditional Polynesian health fruit, easy in Belize.
flavorProfile: Noni has a strong, savory-fruity flavor traditionally used in wellness drinks. The tree is hardy and productive.

name: Pomegranate
description: Jewel-like arils and ornamental flowers.
flavorProfile: Pomegranates are sweet-tart with crunchy, juicy arils. Beautiful on the tree and in the kitchen.

name: Black Sapote
description: The chocolate pudding fruit.
flavorProfile: Ripe black sapote tastes like chocolate pudding — sweet, mild, and custardy. A conversation-piece dessert fruit.

name: White Sapote
description: A creamy, peach-like tropical fruit.
flavorProfile: White sapote is sweet, custardy, and peach-banana flavored with a melt-in-the-mouth texture.

name: Large Pink Cuban Guava
description: A large pink-fleshed Cuban guava.
flavorProfile: Pink Cuban guavas are sweet, floral, and intensely aromatic with a tropical perfume.

name: Chinese Guava
description: Crisp-fleshed guava with a milder, floral taste.
flavorProfile: Chinese guavas have a sweet, mild flavor with tropical and floral notes. Their crunchy texture and juicy flesh make them perfect for fresh eating, juicing, or adding to salads.

name: Strawberry Guava
description: Small red fruit with strawberry-guava perfume.
flavorProfile: Strawberry guavas are sweet-tart with a distinct strawberry aroma. Perfect eaten out of hand.

name: Green Coconut
description: Young green coconut for water and jelly.
flavorProfile: Green coconuts offer sweet, refreshing water and tender jelly. A Belize essential.

name: Yellow Coconut
description: Golden-husked coconut with sweet water.
flavorProfile: Yellow coconuts are sweet and aromatic with excellent drinking water.

name: Orange Coconut
description: A striking orange-husked coconut.
flavorProfile: Orange coconuts have sweet water and an ornamental husk that lights up the garden.

name: Pitaya Red
description: Red-fleshed dragon fruit. A stunning night-blooming cactus.
flavorProfile: Red pitaya is sweet, mildly tropical, and visually spectacular with magenta flesh.

name: Pitaya Yellow
description: Often the sweetest dragon fruit.
flavorProfile: Yellow pitaya is exceptionally sweet with white flesh and a bright yellow skin.

name: Pitaya White
description: Classic white-fleshed dragon fruit.
flavorProfile: White pitaya is refreshing, mildly sweet, and packed with tiny crunchy seeds.

name: Yellow Passion Fruit
description: The tropical passion fruit of the Caribbean.
flavorProfile: Yellow passion fruit is intensely aromatic, sweet-tart, and perfect for juices and desserts.

name: Purple Passion Fruit
description: The classic purple passion fruit.
flavorProfile: Purple passion fruit is fragrant, tangy, and concentrated — a little fruit with huge flavor.

name: Granadilla
description: The sweet, orange-skinned cousin of passion fruit.
flavorProfile: Granadilla has a sweet, tangy flavor with tropical notes. Its juicy, gelatinous pulp is filled with crunchy seeds, offering a refreshing taste that's perfect for fresh eating or adding to fruit salads.

name: Tamarind
description: Sweet-sour pods for drinks, sauces, and candy.
flavorProfile: Tamarind is tangy, sweet, and caramel-like. Essential in Belize drinks and sauces.

name: Soursop (Caribbean)
description: Caribbean guanabana with classic flavor.
flavorProfile: Caribbean soursop is sweet-tart with creamy white pulp and tropical citrus notes. Outstanding in juices.

name: Soursop (Belizean)
description: A local Belize selection.
flavorProfile: Belizean soursop is fragrant, sweet, and creamy — selected for local flavor and performance.

name: Soursop (Brazil Giant)
description: An oversized Brazilian type.
flavorProfile: Brazil Giant soursop produces very large fruit with sweet, abundant pulp — a juice machine.

name: Soursop (Salvadorian)
description: A Central American selection.
flavorProfile: Salvadorian soursop is sweet, aromatic, and creamy with excellent juice quality.

name: Sweet Sop Red (Sugar Apple)
description: Red-skinned sweet sop, also known as sugar apple.
flavorProfile: Red sweetsop is very sweet, custardy, and fragrant — a dessert fruit eaten with a spoon.

name: Sweet Sop Green (Sugar Apple)
description: The classic green sweet sop, also known as sugar apple.
flavorProfile: Green sweetsop is sweet, creamy, and segmented. One of the tropics' great dessert fruits.

name: Yellow Cashew
description: Grown for the cashew apple and the nut.
flavorProfile: Yellow cashew apples are juicy, sweet-tart, and tropical. The nut is the famous cashew.

name: Red Cashew
description: Red cashew apple with a vivid color.
flavorProfile: Red cashew apples are aromatic and tangy-sweet. A beautiful dual-purpose tree.

name: Red Craboo
description: Belize's beloved nance.
flavorProfile: Red craboo is sweet-tart and uniquely tropical — a Belize childhood flavor.

name: Yellow Craboo
description: Golden nance fruit.
flavorProfile: Yellow craboo is fragrant, sweet-tart, and excellent in wines and desserts.

name: Breadfruit
description: A staple tree of the tropics. Air-layered for faster fruiting.
flavorProfile: Breadfruit is starchy, mildly sweet, and potato-like when roasted. A generous food tree.

name: Jackfruit
description: The world's largest tree fruit.
flavorProfile: Jackfruit bulbs are sweet, tropical, and banana-pineapple flavored when ripe. Unripe fruit cooks like a savory meat substitute.

name: Lychee
description: Air-layered lychee for true-to-type fruit. Limited tropical trial plantings.
flavorProfile: Lychees are floral, sweet, and juicy with a rose-grape perfume. A luxury fruit.

name: Mamey (Momeya)
description: The salmon-fleshed mamey sapote.
flavorProfile: Mamey is sweet, creamy, and pumpkin-almond flavored. One of the great tropical dessert fruits.

name: Mangosteen
description: The queen of fruits. Always in short supply at the nursery — a rare tree that sells quickly.
flavorProfile: Mangosteen is delicately sweet with a floral, lychee-like flavor and snow-white segments. A rare treasure in Belize.

name: Papaya
description: Nursery papaya seedling — a fast-growing tropical fruit for Belize gardens.
flavorProfile: Ripe papaya is soft, sweet, and musky with a bright orange flesh. Enjoy fresh, in smoothies, or with lime.
